introduction_summary: Read the full introduction. Verified that scene relationships, text details and transcription are separate clues; the preceding small constructed multimodal MoE differs from the pretrained Qwen starting point; all ten chapter Python blocks run on CPU without model downloads, and the brief parallel-computation GPU definition agrees with official CUDA documentation. Chapter routing sentences are navigation, not separate knowledge claims.
